title: Figure 63: normalized radar cross section plot, dielectric-coated sphere, 50 EPW case
description: ANSYS 'Normalized Radar Cross Section, No Polarization' plot of RCS/lambda^2 (dB) versus theta for the half-symmetry 10 m metallic sphere with 1 m dielectric coating at 300 MHz, computed with 50 elements per wavelength. Mesh-convergence companion to Figure 62 in the BAASS RCS study.
